# List items as typed

* [Top](https://example.com/)
	* a tab for this one
    * four spaces for this one
    * and a deeper level
        * eight spaces

Tab after the marker:

-	Tab after the marker
-	and again

Spacing of its own:

*  Two spaces after the first marker
* one after the next
* --

A whitespace-only line:

* item
	* nested
	
	## A heading in it

A lazy line:

* Four-space nested
    * a
    * b
lazy line

Indented:

  * Indented list
  * second

Nested items of every kind:

* Top
	* [>] a deferred task
	    * [x] a done one
	* ~~[https://example.com/s](https://example.com/s)~~
	* [a reference][ref]
	* [[A wiki link]]
	* - an item starting with a list
	* ![Picture](https://example.com/p.png)

[ref]: https://example.com/r
